Data1DLoading.description:
How to read one trace file into an x-vs-y array.

Mirrors ``geecs_data_utils.io.array1d.Data1DConfig`` field for field —
the reader is handed ``Data1DConfig.model_validate(loading.model_dump())``
— so the schema package stays pydantic-only while the reader keeps its
own model.

data_type.description: File format: 'tek_scope_hdf5' or 'tdms_scope' for scope captures, 'csv' / 'tsv' for delimited text, 'npy' for a saved array, 'pva_stack' for one shot of the per-device capture stack a Bluesky scan writes (traces and spectra alike; the reader takes its axis from the stack and hands back the trace at its true length, never the padded one).

FigureStyle.description:
The per-frame draw: matplotlib keyword groups and overlay styles by id.

Each group passes straight to the matplotlib call of that name and is
validated by rendering (the editor's preview); the analysis core owns
the frame's geometry, so image ``extent`` cannot be set.  ``colorbar.show``
hides the colorbar; an overlay entry's ``hidden`` hides that overlay and
its ``scale`` sets a projection's height as a fraction of the image.
Every summary kind reuses this draw for its panels.

pcolormesh.description: Axes.pcolormesh keywords, used for nonuniform image axes.
pcolormesh.title: Pcolormesh

colorbar.description: Figure.colorbar keywords (label, ...); show: false hides it.
colorbar.title: Colorbar

overlays.description: Style per overlay id the measure emits (projection_x, projection_y, com): Axes.plot keywords, plus hidden and scale.
overlays.title: Overlays

FigureStyle.title: FigureStyle

FrameInput.description:
A frame the source layer loads before the run and binds by name.

Steps refer to it by the key it is stored under (``background_frame``'s
``source``).  The analysis core never opens the path; the scan host
resolves ``{scan_dir}`` to the device's data directory and loads it.

fallback_level.description: When the file cannot be read, subtract this constant instead of the frame and warn; unset makes a failed read an error.

StepRef.description:
One processing step by its registered name, parameters as written.

Every key other than ``step`` is a parameter of that step and is
validated by the analysis core's registry when the recipe compiles
(unknown parameters are refused there, exactly as unknown keys are
refused here for typed sections).

description:
One device's analysis: input, ordered steps, a measure, the draw, the summaries.

The file's stem is the recipe ID that groups reference.  ``device`` is
the device whose folder holds the input files and whose name stems the
product files; ``output_name`` (defaulting to ``device``) labels
everything written — s-file columns, the output folder.

schema_version.description: Format version of this recipe. Leave at 3 — tools update this automatically when the file format changes.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

device.description: The device whose data folder under scans/ScanNNN/ is analyzed.
device.title: Device

output_name.description: Label for everything this recipe writes (s-file column prefix, output folder). Defaults to device; set it to run two recipes over one device with distinct outputs.
output_name.title: Output Name

scalar_suffix.description: Suffix appended to every s-file column name; scalars only, never files or folders.
scalar_suffix.title: Scalar Suffix

metadata.description: Free-form documentary fields; nothing reads them.
metadata.title: Metadata

input.description: Where the frames come from and how one is read.
input.title: Input

inputs.description: Frames loaded before the run and bound by name for steps that take one (a background image).
inputs.title: Inputs

steps.description: Processing steps in order; any order, repeats allowed.
steps.title: Steps

measure.description: What is measured on each processed frame.

figure.description: The per-frame draw, reused by every summary kind.

summaries.description: Scan-level figures, each a frozen kind with its own options; an empty list draws no summary.
summaries.title: Summaries
